responsibility: Defines the Alpha backend’s target options and their bindings to internal masks or variables, including ISA-extension switches, floating-point format and exception controls, code-model choices, CPU/tuning selection, long-double size, TLS settings, and memory-latency tuning. GCC’s option machinery uses this table to parse -m flags, populate Alpha-specific state, and expose those settings to alpha.cc and the machine description.
same_name_distinction: Option-table member of the Alpha stem: it lists Alpha-specific -m switches and their bindings to masks/variables for GCC's option machinery, instead of implementing backend behavior like alpha.cc, defining architectural macros/constants like alpha.h, or describing instruction patterns like alpha.md.
